run_ssd_training: run SSD training on a coding dataset with temperature-based self-distillation and cross-entropy loss
build_ssd_dataset: build a dataset with a prompt column for self-distillation training on coding problems
configure_ssd_trainer: configure the SSDTrainer with a causal LM model, tokenizer, and training arguments
test_ssd_eval: test the SSD trainer by evaluating on a held-out split and logging metrics
summarize_ssd_method: summarize the Simple Self-Distillation method for code generation without reward models or verifiers
